gaps.GET /v1/pm/connections/:name/assignment-: reads a PM connection's assignment trigger (agent identity, change descriptor, on/off)
gaps.PUT /v1/pm/connections/:name/assignment-: sets the assignment trigger; turning it on is a settings_relax step-up
gaps.GET /v1/pm/connections/:name/identity-li: lists which PM users are linked to which RegulAIt users on a connection
gaps.POST /v1/pm/connections/:name/identity-l: links a PM user to a RegulAIt user (admin-managed, never self-asserted)
gaps.DELETE /v1/pm/connections/:name/identity: removes an identity link; that PM user's assignments start nothing
